warnings: Door and window schedule for the whole set: น1 (window 1.20x1.20, sill 0.80), ป1 (composite door 2.00x2.05) and ป2 (PVC door 0.70x2.00). These are the marks tagged all over A-04, A-06 and รูปตัด 2.

ป2 does NOT appear on the main building's floor plan (A-04 tags only ป1 and น1). It is the toilet-block door, which is why it is drawn here but scheduled nowhere on the main plans -- expect it on A-08/A-12.

The window hardware list has ONE item whose text is copied verbatim from the door list, including the phrase 'ติดตั้งบานประตูห้องนอน' (fitted to the BEDROOM DOOR leaf). Read literally it makes no sense as a window item. Transcribed as printed and flagged text_repeats_door_item_verbatim rather than silently reworded.
ป1's 2.00 m overall width is arithmetic (1.20 louvred panel + 0.80 swing leaf), not a printed dimension, and is flagged as derived.
